sentences.japanese: 近くにお祭をやっているまちがありますか。
sentences.english: Are there any towns with festivals near here?

sentences.japanese: 稲の収穫期にはお祭りをする。
sentences.english: A festival is held at the rice harvest.

sentences.japanese: ユダヤ人の過越の祭りが近づき、イエスはエルサレムに上がられた。
sentences.english: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

sentences.japanese: もしジェーンのお母さんが日本にいれば、ひな祭りに招待できるのに。
sentences.english: If Jane's mother were in Japan, I could invite her to the Doll's Festival.

sentences.japanese: メーデーは世界の労働者のお祭りの日でもあります。
sentences.english: May Day is also a festival day for the workers in the world.
